apps/web/components/ask-jovie/AskJovie.t.error: The feedback post is best-effort and its failure is swallowed by design, so the panel has no error UI; AskJovie.test.tsx and the Offline story cover the rejected request.
apps/web/components/ask-jovie/AskJovie.t.permission-denied: The panel needs no permission or role and renders for every signed-in user.

apps/web/components/features/admin/Found.error: A failed decision write keeps the draft and shows the server message in the rail (covered by the keeps the draft and surfaces the server error test); the registry has no standing error screen.

apps/web/components/features/admin/admin.loading: The rows arrive as server-rendered initial data and the table shows rows or the empty state; the only pending state is the infinite-scroll fetch, which AdminDataTable owns and its own stories cover.
apps/web/components/features/admin/admin.error: A failed page fetch is handled by the query layer and AdminDataTable; this component renders only the rows it is given.
apps/web/components/features/admin/admin.offline: Rows come from server-rendered initial data and a background query; offline just leaves the loaded rows in place, with no distinct UI.

apps/web/components/features/admin/admin.loading: Rows come from server-rendered data and the infinite query; the only pending state is the next-page fetch, which AdminDataTable owns.
apps/web/components/features/admin/admin.error: A failed query is caught by the QueryErrorBoundary and TableErrorFallback, which have their own stories; the table renders only the rows it is given.
apps/web/components/features/admin/admin.offline: Rows are server-rendered initial data; offline leaves the loaded rows in place with no distinct UI.
apps/web/components/features/admin/admin.permission-denied: The admin route guard blocks non-admins before this table renders, so no permission-denied UI exists here.

apps/web/components/features/admin/campa.loading: The loading branch shows for one query tick and Storybook has no pending-query hook; CampaignSettingsPanel.test.tsx holds the fetch open and asserts it with an axe run.
apps/web/components/features/admin/campa.empty: The panel always shows numeric defaults (DEFAULT_THROTTLING and fixed starting values); there is no collection that can be empty.
apps/web/components/features/admin/campa.long-content: Every field is a number input or a fixed label, so no caller text can grow.
apps/web/components/features/admin/campa.offline: An offline request fails like any other and shows the load error (the ErrorLoadFailed story); saved values already in the form stay in place.

apps/web/components/features/admin/conta.loading: Rows are server-rendered for the current page; the only pending state is the lifecycle detail fetch inside the right panel, which AdminContactsTable.test.tsx holds open and asserts.
apps/web/components/features/admin/conta.error: A failed stage change or evidence review shows a toast and restores the actions (covered by the surfaces a failed stage transition test); the table has no standing error screen.
apps/web/components/features/admin/conta.offline: Rows are server-rendered and filters are plain GET navigation; offline cannot reach a distinct UI state.
